prompt:
Read the dataset (input file: "Fish.csv") and keep only the dataset's four categories of Bream, Roach, Parkki, and Perch. Encode the dataset to divide it into training and test sets. From each of these four categories, randomly select 2 samples for the test set. The remaining samples will be used as the training set. Output the number of samples in the training and test sets in a CSV file named "sample_counts.csv" with the columns "Set" and "Sample Count", the first row holding "Training" and the second row holding "Test".

Next, implement the KNN algorithm with K values of 1, 5, 15, and 100 to classify all samples in the test set. Output the classification results of the test samples to a CSV file named "classification_results.csv" with one row per test sample per K value and the columns "Test Sample Index", "True Species Code", "Predicted Species Code", "K", and "Accuracy", where the species codes are the encoded species labels and "Accuracy" is the accuracy on the test set for that K value.
